law_and_dates.original_law: 2017 XII2(a)/3/4/5 PDF334-336: four stated Seasons plus one player Option; A-type protection. Original June29 contractdeadline is selected fictional contract term, not proof of an actual private LaVine deadline.
law_and_dates.operative_law: 2023 XII2(a)/3/4/5 PDF360-362; effective July1,2023 under XXXIX1 PDF566.
law_and_dates.option_holder: PLAYER_ONLY; Chicago cannot exercise on his behalf.
law_and_dates.notice_scope: Voluntary player-signed written exercise notice, emailed to Chicago designated contract recipient; receipt by the Team in the contract-permitted exercise window is an admitted fictional condition. Any additionally required original UPC method/recipient is fulfilled concurrently. The recipient is a typed authorized channel, not a real private address.
law_and_dates.email_channel_legal_basis_precision: XII5 describes Team->NBA->NBPA notices but does not prescribe or deem-sent a player-to-Team email. Email acceptance and any UPC-specific notice formalities are explicit lawful notice-domain conditions; no new salary/option contingency or deadline extension is created. If the existing contractual channel does not accept email alone, compliant written delivery accompanies the email by the same deadline.
law_and_dates.CBA_NBA_to_NBPA_copy_deadline: XII5: within two business days of NBA receipt of the notice from the Team; modeled NBA receipt June29 entails July1,2026 absent an applicable non-business-day adjustment.
law_and_dates.contract_window_condition: t_notice lies in original permitted exercise interval and <=June29 17:00ET; original A protection has no XII2(a)(B)-specific last-Team-game earliest-exercise restriction. B restriction is not imported.
law_and_dates.service_fiscal_separation: FY25 fiscal ends June30,2026; fiscal boundary is not certification of completion of all original services. NBA Season ends with last Finals game, whose date/champion is unselected here. Option notice and performance of services are separate obligations.

common_domain.option_protection: A as selected, remains as if exercised on Team termination before exercise. Nonexercise is not an automatic waiver of a preceding protected termination obligation.
